description: University Grants Commission- The Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978 Amendment to the Institute of Biochemistry, molecullar Biology and Biotechnology Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content contains amendments to an existing ordinance (The Institute of Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Biotechnology Ordinance) made under the Universities Act, which constitutes legal/regulatory modifications. It involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for academic institutions, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with legal amendments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
